chart: Share of Battery Electric Car Inventory with and without Regulation, United States 2026-2050
unit: percent of total light duty vehicle stock
method: Both curves were traced from the reference image: gridlines calibrate the axes (0% to 50% in 5-point steps, 2025 to 2050 in 5-year steps); each line's centre was sampled at every year. The first two years of the 'with regulation' line are hidden under the 'without regulation' line in the image, so it starts from the same point (2026) and is interpolated for 2027. Accuracy is about +/-0.3 percentage points.
note: End values (46.2% and 18.3%) agree with the EIA Annual Energy Outlook 2026 figures used in 7C (46% with the standards, 18% without). The reference shows no source credit.
